mechanisms.scroll: xxxSetLBScrollParms computes original horizontal/vertical page/range and uses its original no-change cache. It calls mapped SetScrollInfo, then stores the actual return. Native wrapper translates HWND and enters/exits the same native-call boundary in finally. Keep cache algorithm C; inspect boundary as one group, not a second scroll implementation.
mechanisms.items: Original GrowMem/xxxLBInsertItem/LBCalcAllocNeeded own item data, string offsets, selection and variable-height storage. Actual HeapAlloc/ReAlloc/Free and locale APIs are native imports. No F allocator or sorting engine is required.
mechanisms.encoding: WCSToMBEx resolves C chartran.obj; RtlUnicodeToMultiByteSize resolves NTDLL. Do not replace original conversion or introduce a duplicate encoding path.
mechanisms.callbacks: Original insertion sends WM_MEASUREITEM after incrementing cMac, then stores returned itemHeight. Sorting sends WM_COMPAREITEM; deletion notifies WM_DELETEITEM. Selected SendMessageW uses current native-call scope and result-publication hook. Original wmtbl32/wmdisp32 already select and implement WM32MeasureItem/DeleteItem/CompareItem; WM32MeasureItem handles MIFLAG_FLAT and updates returned fields. This is static chain evidence, not proof of arbitrary callback mutation safety.
mechanisms.internalDispatch: Single-item deletion and zero SetCount call SendMessageWorker for LB_RESETCONTENT. F wow_window_client_send_message retains exact PWND in existing borrow scope before converting to HWND and calling native A/W. A numeric HWND alone does not preserve the original allocation across reentrant destruction. S13 must preserve that ownership while eliminating outward C coupling.
mechanisms.metrics: Default measure height reads gpsi->cySysFontChar through wow_edit_current TLS snapshot established by the shared control entry. It is not per-item persistent ownership.
